title: Configure ICP payment address on the registration/login page

requirements.text: Add a backend function that allows the canister owner/admin to set and update the ICP payment address (ownerIcpAddress) used for payment gating. This function should be restricted to the canister owner and persist the address in stable storage.

quotes: Bitte Zahlungsadresse auf der Anmeldung konfigurieren

acceptanceCriteria: A callable function `setOwnerIcpAddress(address: Text)` exists in the backend actor restricted to the canister owner.
The address is persisted and returned correctly by the existing `getOwnerIcpAddress` query.
Calling the function as a non-owner returns an error or is rejected.

requirements.text: Add an admin configuration panel or modal accessible from the PaymentGate screen (or a separate admin-only route) that allows the owner to view and update the ICP payment wallet address. The panel should display the current configured address and provide an input field plus save button to update it. Only show this UI when the authenticated user is the canister owner.

quotes: Bitte Zahlungsadresse auf der Anmeldung konfigurieren

acceptanceCriteria: The admin configuration UI is only visible to the canister owner when authenticated.
The current ICP payment address is pre-filled in the input field on load.
Saving a new address calls the backend `setOwnerIcpAddress` function and shows a success/error toast notification.
The PaymentGate screen immediately reflects the updated address after a successful save.
Non-owner users do not see the configuration UI on the PaymentGate screen.

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo.
Admin-only backend functions must be restricted to the canister owner principal.
Generate migration.mo if stable state fields are added or changed.
nonGoals: Changing the visual design or layout of the PaymentGate beyond adding the admin configuration UI.
Adding a separate admin dashboard or admin routing infrastructure.
